title: 公共服务与法律精选 · 36 句
description: 围绕本主题的具体情境组织表达；覆盖请求、说明、比较与复合句，并附逐题用法。

items.zh: 我想确认这份表格是否需要本人签名。
items.en: I'd like to check whether this form needs my signature.
answers: I'd like to check whether this form needs my signature.
I would like to check whether this form needs my signature.
items.notes: whether 引导宾语从句；signature 为签名的名词形式。

items.zh: 除了身份证明，我还需要带哪些文件？
items.en: What documents should I bring apart from proof of identity?
answers: What documents should I bring apart from proof of identity?
items.notes: apart from 表示除……之外；proof of identity 指身份证明。

items.zh: 如果申请被拒绝，通知中会说明原因吗？
items.en: If the application is refused, will the notice explain the reasons?
answers: If the application is refused, will the notice explain the reasons?
items.notes: 条件从句用一般现在时被动，主句用 will；refuse an application 指拒绝申请。

items.zh: 我提交申请已经三周了，还没有收到回复。
items.en: It's been three weeks since I submitted the application, and I haven't received a reply yet.
answers: It's been three weeks since I submitted the application, and I haven't received a reply yet.
It's been three weeks since I submitted the application, and I have not received a reply yet.
items.notes: it has been + 时间 + since ... 说明经过的时长；yet 常用于否定句。

items.zh: 请告诉我在哪里可以查看这项规定的完整文本。
items.en: Please tell me where I can read the full text of this rule.
answers: Please tell me where I can read the full text of this rule.
items.notes: 间接疑问句 where I can 使用陈述语序；full text 指完整文本。

items.zh: 虽然网站说可以在线办理，但这个页面一直无法打开。
items.en: Although the website says the service is available online, this page won't load.
answers: Although the website says the service is available online, this page won't load.
Although the website says the service is available online, this page will not load.
items.notes: although 对比承诺与实际情况；won't load 表示页面无法加载。

items.zh: 我需要一位口译员，帮助我理解面谈中的问题。
items.en: I need an interpreter to help me understand the questions during the interview.
answers: I need an interpreter to help me understand the questions during the interview.
items.notes: interpreter 指口译员；translator 通常指笔译人员。

items.zh: 在截止日期之前，我可以补交缺少的材料吗？
items.en: Can I submit the missing documents before the deadline?
answers: Can I submit the missing documents before the deadline?
items.notes: submit documents 表示提交材料；deadline 为截止日期。

items.zh: 让我困惑的是，通知上的金额和网上显示的不一样。
items.en: What confuses me is that the amount on the notice differs from the one shown online.
answers: What confuses me is that the amount on the notice differs from the one shown online.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；one 代指 amount，shown online 是分词定语。

items.zh: 您能说明申请复核有哪些步骤，以及相关期限吗？
items.en: Could you explain the steps for requesting a review and the relevant time limits?
answers: Could you explain the steps for requesting a review and the relevant time limits?
items.notes: request a review 表示申请复核；此句询问当地程序，不预设具体法律期限。

items.zh: 如果需要原件，请提前通知我，以便我安排递交。
items.en: If the originals are required, please let me know in advance so that I can arrange to submit them.
answers: If the originals are required, please let me know in advance so that I can arrange to submit them.
items.notes: if 提出条件，so that 说明提前通知的目的；originals 指文件原件。

items.zh: 与其猜测表格的意思，我宁愿请工作人员逐项解释。
items.en: Rather than guess what the form means, I'd prefer to ask a member of staff to explain each section.
answers: Rather than guess what the form means, I'd prefer to ask a member of staff to explain each section.
items.notes: prefer to do 表示更愿意；each section 强调逐项解释。

items.zh: 预约确认上没有写办理地点。
items.en: The appointment confirmation does not specify the location.
answers: The appointment confirmation does not specify the location.
The appointment confirmation doesn't specify the location.
items.notes: specify：明确写明。

items.zh: 我可以带复印件，还是必须出示原件？
items.en: Can I bring copies, or must I present the originals?
answers: Can I bring copies, or must I present the originals?
items.notes: present：出示。

items.zh: 姓名变更后，需要更新哪些证件？
items.en: Which documents need to be updated after a name change?
answers: Which documents need to be updated after a name change?
items.notes: need to be updated：需要更新。

items.zh: 这项申请能由授权代表递交吗？
items.en: Can an authorised representative submit this application?
answers: Can an authorised representative submit this application?
items.notes: authorised representative：授权代表。

items.zh: 我想查询申请编号，而不是重新提交一份。
items.en: I want to look up the application reference rather than submit a new application.
answers: I want to look up the application reference rather than submit a new application.
items.notes: look up：查询。

items.zh: 表格上的地址栏容不下我的完整地址。
items.en: The address field on the form is too short for my full address.
answers: The address field on the form is too short for my full address.
items.notes: field 指表格字段。

items.zh: 如果没有固定住址，可以使用什么联系地址？
items.en: What contact address can be used if someone has no fixed home address?
answers: What contact address can be used if someone has no fixed home address?
items.notes: fixed address：固定地址。

items.zh: 我收到的通知似乎是寄给前一位住户的。
items.en: The notice I received appears to be intended for the previous resident.
answers: The notice I received appears to be intended for the previous resident.
items.notes: be intended for：原本是给某人的。

items.zh: 能否给我一个受理凭证，证明材料已经交齐？
items.en: Could I have an acknowledgement confirming that all required documents have been received?
answers: Could I have an acknowledgement confirming that all required documents have been received?
items.notes: acknowledgement：收件确认。

items.zh: 办理费用可以刷卡支付吗？
items.en: Can the processing fee be paid by card?
answers: Can the processing fee be paid by card?
items.notes: processing fee：办理费用。

items.zh: 如果预约当天无法到场，应该怎样改期？
items.en: How should I reschedule if I cannot attend on the appointment date?
answers: How should I reschedule if I cannot attend on the appointment date?
How should I reschedule if I can't attend on the appointment date?
items.notes: reschedule：重新安排时间。

items.zh: 排号机没有打印出号码，我应该在哪里等？
items.en: The ticket machine did not print a number; where should I wait?
answers: The ticket machine did not print a number; where should I wait?
The ticket machine didn't print a number; where should I wait?
items.notes: ticket machine 在此指取号机。

items.zh: 我需要无障碍入口的位置说明。
items.en: I need directions to the accessible entrance.
answers: I need directions to the accessible entrance.
items.notes: directions：路线指引。

items.zh: 这份证明的有效期从签发日开始计算吗？
items.en: Does this certificate's validity period start on the issue date?
answers: Does this certificate's validity period start on the issue date?
items.notes: issue date：签发日期。

items.zh: 网上的要求和柜台提供的信息似乎不一致。
items.en: The online requirements seem inconsistent with the information provided at the counter.
answers: The online requirements seem inconsistent with the information provided at the counter.
items.notes: inconsistent with：与……不一致。

items.zh: 请说明这次决定依据的是哪条规定。
items.en: Please identify the rule on which this decision is based.
answers: Please identify the rule on which this decision is based.
items.notes: on which 引导定语从句。

items.zh: 我想了解投诉渠道，但暂时不提交正式投诉。
items.en: I would like information about the complaints process without filing a formal complaint yet.
answers: I would like information about the complaints process without filing a formal complaint yet.
I'd like information about the complaints process without filing a formal complaint yet.
items.notes: file a complaint：提交投诉。

items.zh: 是否有可以协助填写表格的工作人员？
items.en: Is there a staff member who can help me complete the form?
answers: Is there a staff member who can help me complete the form?
items.notes: who 限定可提供帮助的人。

items.zh: 请把联系偏好设置为邮件，而不是电话。
items.en: Please set my contact preference to email rather than telephone.
answers: Please set my contact preference to email rather than telephone.
items.notes: contact preference：首选联系方式。

items.zh: 我需要更正档案中拼错的姓氏。
items.en: I need to correct the misspelling of my surname in the record.
answers: I need to correct the misspelling of my surname in the record.
items.notes: misspelling：拼写错误。

items.zh: 这份译文需要经过认证吗？
items.en: Does this translation need to be certified?
answers: Does this translation need to be certified?
items.notes: certified：经认证的。

items.zh: 新规定什么时候开始适用于已提交的申请？
items.en: When will the new rule apply to applications already submitted?
answers: When will the new rule apply to applications already submitted?
items.notes: apply to：适用于。

items.zh: 如果没有收到确认邮件，是否意味着提交失败了？
items.en: If no confirmation email arrives, does that mean the submission failed?
answers: If no confirmation email arrives, does that mean the submission failed?
items.notes: that 指代未收到邮件的情况。

items.zh: 请告诉我怎样获取自己所提交材料的副本。
items.en: Please tell me how to obtain copies of the documents I submitted.
answers: Please tell me how to obtain copies of the documents I submitted.
items.notes: how to do：如何做某事。
